title: Can we trust this claim?
intro: Trace an attractive claim from a shared message to an evidence-based response. Three decisions, multiple consequences and space to reflect.

nodes.title: The situation
nodes.body: A colleague shares a striking statistic and asks you to use it in tomorrow's workshop. There is no source in the message.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 1
nodes.body: The original report describes a small local sample. The headline in the message removed that context.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 1
nodes.body: Several sites repeat the same number. Their agreement looks reassuring until you notice that they all cite one unsourced post.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 1
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Compare the evidence
nodes.body: A second report gives a different result. How do you respond?

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 2
nodes.body: The reports measure different outcomes in different groups. You can explain why their numbers should not be treated as direct opposites.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 2
nodes.body: Your slide has a strong opening, but a participant asks whether the samples are comparable. Your notes do not yet answer that question.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 2
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Communicate uncertainty
nodes.body: How will you present the evidence?

choices.label: State the limits and cite the source
Present the number as a universal fact

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 3
nodes.body: You distinguish what the evidence suggests from what it cannot establish. Participants have a source they can inspect.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 3
nodes.body: The message is simple, but stronger than the evidence. You need a correction before using it as learning material.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 3
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Your route, your explanation
nodes.body: Write the claim you would now feel comfortable sharing. Include its source, limits and a question that remains open.
nodes.prompt: What would you keep or change next time?
